mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to build an app in India?

acceptedAnswer.text: A simple app costs far less than a complex marketplace or fintech app. Ladder7 builds enterprise-grade apps at affordable, flexible pricing and provides a fixed estimate after a short discovery session.

mainEntity.name: Flutter or native: which should we choose?

acceptedAnswer.text: Flutter suits most business apps because one codebase serves Android and iOS. Native is better for heavy device integration, complex animation or very high performance.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to build a mobile app?

acceptedAnswer.text: A focused first version usually takes 10 to 16 weeks including design, build, testing and store submission.

mainEntity.name: Do you publish the app to the stores?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We handle App Store and Google Play submission under your developer accounts, so you own the listings.

content.text: How much does it cost to build an app in India?

A simple app costs far less than a complex marketplace or fintech app. Ladder7 builds enterprise-grade apps at affordable, flexible pricing and provides a fixed estimate after a short discovery session.
Flutter or native: which should we choose?
Flutter suits most business apps because one codebase serves Android and iOS. Native is better for heavy device integration, complex animation or very high performance.
How long does it take to build a mobile app?
A focused first version usually takes 10 to 16 weeks including design, build, testing and store submission.
Do you publish the app to the stores?
Yes. We handle App Store and Google Play submission under your developer accounts, so you own the listings.
